title: suggest_emojis output
description: Emoji suggestions for the text. Confidences are raw softmax probabilities, not calibrated probabilities, and a suggestion is a ranked hint rather than a promise that the emoji fits.

suggestions.description: The top `limit` labels by descending probability, exact ties broken by ascending label index.

emoji.description: The emoji string from emo_meta.json labels[index].

confidence.description: The label's raw softmax probability; uncalibrated.

labels.description: The model's label-space size (812 emoji labels), not the number of suggestions.
